transfer_policy: one-way-to-work; never sync company modifications back

connections.discover_at_work: Approved issuer/subject, membership provisioning and session/revocation conventions; do not infer roles from email
connections.acceptance: Real login, incorrect audience, disabled identity, group removal and logout tests

connections.discover_at_work: Approved BigQuery/dbt views and actual delegated identity model, not a shared owner service account
connections.acceptance: Two real test identities see different authorized rows; caller cannot choose execution principal or submit SQL; disabled identities fail

connections.discover_at_work: Actual catalog/dbt manifest, model grain tests, lineage to underlying policies, sensitivity tags, freshness watermark and negative test identities
connections.acceptance: POST trusted Observation; changing a view, schema, policy, grain or freshness causes runtime denial until recertified

connections.discover_at_work: Isolated Cloud Build or equivalent, approved base digests/registries, complete transitive inventories, secret/vulnerability/license scanners and attestations
connections.acceptance: Untrusted code cannot access worker credentials, metadata service, host socket or company network; missing index.html, unapproved packages and bad/expired scans block admission; schedule digest-bound rescans and reconcile cancelled/orphan external jobs

connections.discover_at_work: Approved Cloud Run or equivalent region, private ingress, scoped runtime identity, authenticated edge and gateway routing
connections.acceptance: Only approved image runs; direct platform URL bypass fails; image/health/resource/egress checks pass; revoked app and preview access fail closed

connections.discover_at_work: Company edge authenticates each user and obtains short-lived app-and-release-bound runtime tokens; implement work-edge-sessions.mjs for approved encrypted shared sessions; strip incoming identity headers and isolate per-app origins
connections.acceptance: Spoofed headers, cross-app tokens, old releases, disabled users, direct ingress and unauthorized viewers are denied; browser receives no backend token; two replicas/restart preserve caller isolation; expired or unavailable session storage denies access

connections.discover_at_work: Approved company Claude/model endpoint, data residency and retention policy, UI repository context and design conventions
connections.acceptance: Proposal is source-digest-bound and UI-only; prompt injection cannot edit IAM, SQL, Dockerfile or secrets; candidate requires fresh build and independent analytical/golden-result review, even when only JSX changes

connections.discover_at_work: Separate control/state databases, migration owners versus gateway roles, IAM auth/secret rotation, backups and retention
connections.acceptance: State runtime role is non-owner/non-superuser/NOBYPASSRLS; FORCE RLS cross-user/app tests; concurrent CAS/idempotency tests; restore drill

connections.discover_at_work: Approved append-only sink and retention; export transactional audit_outbox with delivery deduplication
connections.acceptance: App actors cannot rewrite history; outages retain events; replay deduplicates; rows/prompts/tokens are excluded from audit payloads
